const MOD = 1000000007;

class Parser {

        $input = file_get_contents('php://stdin');

        if ($this->index >= count($this->tokens)) return null;
        return $this->tokens[$this->index++];
    }

    public function nextInt() {
        return (int)$this->next();
    }

    public function nextLong() {
        return (int)$this->next();

    }

        $ret = new Matrix($n);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $ret->a[$i][$i] = 1;
        }
        return $ret;
    }

    public function multiply(Matrix $b, $mod) {
        $resp = new Matrix($this->n);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $this->n; $i++) {
            for ($j = 0; $j < $this->n; $j++) {
                $sum = 0;
                for ($k = 0; $k < $this->n; $k++) {
                    $sum = ($sum + $this->a[$i][$k] * $b->a[$k][$j]) % $mod;
                }
                $resp->a[$i][$j] = $sum;
            }
        }
        return $resp;
    }

    public function modpow($exp, $mod) {
        if ($exp == 0) return self::identity($this->n);
        if ($exp == 1) return $this;
        $h = $this->modpow($exp >> 1, $mod);

}

class TaskC {
    public function solve($testNumber, Parser $in, OutputWriter $out) {
        $n = $in->nextLong();
        $k = $in->nextInt();

        $pas = MathUtils::pas(41, MOD);
        $a = new Matrix(83);

        $a->a[0][0] = 1;
        $a->a[0][$k+1] = 1;

        for ($pot = 0; $pot <= 40; $pot++) {
            for ($coef = 0; $coef <= $pot; $coef++) {
                $a->a[$pot+1][$coef+1] = $pas[$pot][$coef];
                $pow2 = (1 << ($pot - $coef)) % MOD;
                $a->a[$pot+1][$coef+42] = ($pas[$pot][$coef] * $pow2) % MOD;
            }
        }

        for ($pot = 0; $pot <= 40; $pot++) {
            $a->a[$pot+42][$pot+1] = 1;
        }

        $b = new Matrix(83);
        for ($i = 1; $i <= 42; $i++) {
            $b->a[$i][0] = 1;
        }

        $a = $a->modpow($n, MOD);
        $a = $a->multiply($b, MOD);

        $out->println($a->a[0][0]);
    }
}

            for ($j = 1; $j <= $i; $j++) {

class Matrix {
    public $n;
    public $a;

        $this->a = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $this->a[$i] = array_fill(0, $n, 0);
        }

    public static function identity($n) {
        $ret = new Matrix($n);
        for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
            $ret->a[$i][$i] = 1;
        }
        return $ret;
    }

    public function multiply($b, $mod) {

            }
        }

    }

    public function modpow($exp, $mod) {
        if ($exp == 0) return self::identity($this->n);

source_data.prob_desc_description: Everyone knows what the Fibonacci sequence is. This sequence can be defined by the recurrence relation: F1 = 1, F2 = 2, Fi = Fi - 1 + Fi - 2 (i > 2).We'll define a new number sequence Ai(k) by the formula: Ai(k) = Fi × ik (i ≥ 1).In this problem, your task is to calculate the following sum: A1(k) + A2(k) + ... + An(k). The answer can be very large, so print it modulo 1000000007 (109 + 7).
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: Print a single integer — the sum of the first n elements of the sequence Ai(k) modulo 1000000007 (109 + 7).
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The first line contains two space-separated integers n, k (1 ≤ n ≤ 1017; 1 ≤ k ≤ 40).
